title: PCI DSS Level 1 Readiness Plan and Regulated Data Control Pack

_meta.pack_id_policy: Keep PCI-DSS-L1-v4 as the stable Level 1 pack identifier for compatibility; carry the precise PCI SSC standard revision in standard_version and source_revision fields. The stable pack id is not evidence that v4.0.1 control text has been extracted or accepted.
_meta.source_revision_status: PCI SSC document library page is reachable, but the direct PCI DSS v4.0.1 PDF remains blocked with HTTP 403 in this environment. This artifact reconciles source/version metadata only and does not extract exact control text.
_meta.claim_ceiling: Planning/source-version coverage only. No PCI DSS Level 1 readiness, ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV readiness, v4.0.1 control completeness, CDE runtime, tenant activation, or evidence-acceptance claim is made by this artifact.

accepted_adr_anchors.binding: PCI remains a HARD_DENY data class for advertising and analytics; payment-card derived data inherits the most restrictive applicable class.
Any future implementation, review, and promotion work uses plain git isolated worktree branches and protected PRs rather than retired Oya VCS/CLI ratchets.
The single required presubmit context is the merge/admission authority for future PRs; local legacy CLI output is not readiness or merge authority.

Target-state compliance-pack/cell-certification model alignment only; not tenant activation or certification authority.
Target-state observability/audit emission alignment only; not runtime logging or evidence acceptance authority.

tenant activation gate runtime or Cedar fragment activation

_meta.owner_team: ops-compliance + council-security + axis-identity + axis-policy-engine + axis-audit-chain + axis-cloud-kms
_meta.binding_directive: PCI DSS Level 1 is the minimum platform floor for any cardholder-data or payment-card control-plane surface.
_meta.purpose: Define the planning-only PCI DSS Level 1 readiness contract for CDE scoping, tokenization, card-data prohibitions, QSA evidence, scans, segmentation, KMS/PDP/audit bindings, retention, incident response, and tenant pack activation gates.

source_contracts.contract: Stable PCI-DSS-L1-v4 pack shape plus PCI DSS standard_version/source_revision metadata, data-class extensions, cell eligibility, retention rules, breach workflow, BYOK flags
Stable PCI-DSS-L1-v4 DR floor and annual drill cadence with PCI DSS v4.0.1 source revision metadata
Official PCI SSC source rows, blocked v4.0.1 PDF acquisition state, stable pack-id policy, and claim ceiling for readiness/ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV evidence
PCI data class is HARD_DENY for advertising and analytics; derived data inherits the most restrictive class
Pack activation, data access, retention, and cross-cell decisions are Cedar-gated with default deny
Embedded PDP port; every allow/deny decision emits an attributable audit record and fails closed on audit-chain emission error
KMS encrypt/decrypt/schedule-delete API boundary requires tenant, principal, authorization receipt, data_class, purpose, idempotency, region, and cell context
Audit envelope carries tenant, audit id, source service, cell, jurisdiction, trace/span/event ids, HLC timestamp, cost, carbon, provider, and region
Every regulated cross-pillar flow emits audit evidence and applies KMS/redaction/DSR constraints

non_claims: No cardholder data environment is implemented by this artifact.
No payment processor, token vault, network segment, KMS runtime, Cedar fragment, ASV scan, QSA assessment, ROC, AOC, or tenant activation runtime is claimed green by this artifact.

No PCI DSS v4.0.1 control completeness, source-row extraction completeness, ROC/AOC template completeness, QSA evidence sufficiency, or ASV scan sufficiency is claimed while the official v4.0.1 PDF is blocked.
No CLI surface or oya/cloud reorganization target path is introduced by this artifact.
All runtime controls below are target-state acceptance criteria for downstream implementation and review.

readiness_floor.stable_pack_id_policy: Do not rename the pack id to include patch-level standard revisions; use standard_version and source_revision for PCI SSC publication updates so downstream pack activation references remain stable while source rows stay precise.

source_revision.official_text_extraction_state: blocked; exact v4.0.1 requirement text must be acquired from PCI SSC under permitted access terms before detailed control rows or evidence acceptance
source_revision.freshness_cadence: monthly retry while blocked; quarterly and on PCI SSC update after permitted PDF acquisition

readiness_floor.floor_rule: Treat Level 1 readiness as mandatory for every Oyatie-managed surface that can create, receive, process, store, decrypt, display, transmit, route, monitor, back up, or administratively affect cardholder data or sensitive authentication data.
lower_validation_profiles_refused: tenant-local exception that stores CVV, track data, PIN, or raw PAN outside the CDE
readiness_floor.allowed_scope_reduction_strategy: Use tokenization and hosted processor fields to reduce the CDE boundary, but only after data-flow evidence proves raw PAN/SAD never reaches non-CDE Oyatie surfaces. Scope reduction never relaxes audit, PDP, KMS, or incident-response evidence for the remaining CDE.

migration_notes_v4_0_to_v4_0_1.compatibility_decision: PCI-DSS-L1-v4 remains the stable pack id; standard_version=4.0.1 is the authoritative standard revision field for this readiness plan and related pack/floor rows.
must_not_do: Do not infer PCI DSS Level 1 readiness from the stable pack id.
Do not accept ROC/AOC/QSA/ASV evidence against v4.0.1 until official standard text and applicable PCI SSC template/source rows are acquired and hashed.
Do not create Cedar fragments, evidence-acceptance rows, tenant activation gates, or CDE runtime controls from the blocked PDF pointer alone.
required_follow_up_before_control_extrac: Acquire the official PCI DSS v4.0.1 PDF under permitted PCI SSC access terms and record content hash, size, date, and source URL.
Create source rows for applicable PCI DSS ROC template, AOC template, QSA program/assessor authority, and ASV program/scan authority.
Reconcile each pre-existing PCI DSS control reference below to exact v4.0.1 wording before changing evidence-acceptance or tenant-activation logic.

roc_aoc_qsa_asv_rows.required_before_acceptance: Official PCI SSC ROC template/source row with version/effective date, content hash or access record, and QSA applicability notes.

roc_aoc_qsa_asv_rows.purpose: Attestation of Compliance template/source authority for customer-facing attestation packet strategy.
roc_aoc_qsa_asv_rows.required_before_acceptance: Official PCI SSC AOC template/source row with version/effective date, content hash or access record, and customer-facing disclosure boundary.

roc_aoc_qsa_asv_rows.required_before_acceptance: Official PCI SSC QSA program/source row with eligibility, engagement, and evidence-sufficiency boundaries; no self-assessed QSA readiness claim.

roc_aoc_qsa_asv_rows.purpose: Approved Scanning Vendor source authority for external scan cadence, scope, failed-scan handling, and re-scan evidence.
roc_aoc_qsa_asv_rows.required_before_acceptance: Official PCI SSC ASV program/source row with scan-cadence and passing/failed scan treatment; no ASV readiness claim until source row and evidence are current.

source_row_strategy.claim_ceiling: Rows above define acquisition strategy only. They do not satisfy ROC, AOC, QSA, ASV, tenant activation, or PCI DSS Level 1 readiness evidence.

regulated_data_classes.meaning: Card PAN, CVV, account number, and payment-card regulated data; HARD_DENY for advertising and analytics.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: deny raw storage unless explicitly covered by CDE scope and PCI pack controls

regulated_data_classes.meaning: Primary account number or any cleartext/encrypted representation from which PAN can be recovered.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: tokenize at ingestion; encrypted PAN storage only inside attested CDE vault surfaces with business justification and key-custody evidence

regulated_data_classes.meaning: Magnetic-stripe or equivalent full track data.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: storage prohibited after authorization; transient memory handling only inside attested payment authorization boundary

regulated_data_classes.meaning: Card verification code/value and equivalent sensitive authentication data.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: storage prohibited after authorization; never logged, indexed, cached, retained, backed up, or replayed

regulated_data_classes.meaning: PIN or PIN block and equivalent authentication secret.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: storage prohibited after authorization; never logged, indexed, cached, retained, backed up, or replayed

regulated_data_classes.meaning: Irreversible or vault-backed substitute value for PAN, scoped to tenant, processor, cell, and purpose.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: allowed outside CDE only when token cannot be reversed without CDE vault + KMS + PDP decision; token metadata remains tenant-scoped regulated data

regulated_data_classes.meaning: Display-safe truncated PAN, normally BIN/IIN plus last four or a stricter mask.
regulated_data_classes.default_storage_rule: allowed only with display-purpose Cedar permit, audit emission, and no reconstruction path from adjacent fields

cde_scope_model.scope_decision_rule: A surface is in CDE scope when it can touch raw PAN/SAD, decrypt cardholder data, administer a card-data control, alter a CDE network boundary, change a CDE KMS key/policy, change a PDP fragment that permits CDE access, change tokenization rules, or read/write CDE audit evidence.
in_scope_surface_classes: payment intake and authorization adapters that receive PAN or SAD
tokenization/vault components that generate, detokenize, rotate, or revoke card tokens
KMS keys, HSM partitions, envelope keys, BYOK roots, and deletion/shred workflows protecting cardholder data
embedded PDP bundles and Cedar fragments that permit card-data actions
audit-chain and observability paths that record CDE access, redaction, key use, tokenization, detokenization, policy decisions, scans, and incidents
network segments, service accounts, CI/CD deploy actors, backups, DR paths, and admin workflows that can affect CDE confidentiality or integrity
out_of_scope_requires_all: no raw PAN, SAD, CVV, track data, PIN, or reversible token reaches the surface
only tokenized or masked data is visible
PDP forbids detokenization and KMS decrypt actions from the surface
logs, traces, metrics, search indexes, analytics, backups, and debug dumps prove redaction/no-ingest controls
segmentation evidence proves no path from the surface into the CDE except through explicitly authorized APIs
required_scope_artifacts: CDE data-flow diagram covering intake, tokenization, authorization, settlement, chargeback, refund, retention, backup, and incident paths
system-component inventory with tenant_id, cell_id, data_class, key_id, policy_bundle_version, and service owner
network segmentation diagram with default-deny boundaries and allowed flows
CDE responsibility matrix for Oyatie, tenant, acquirer, processor, QSA, ASV, and any service provider
scope-change register for every new field, service, token format, KMS key, PDP fragment, observability stream, backup path, or admin role touching payment data

controls.title: CDE scoping and scope-change governance
controls.objective: Keep raw cardholder-data paths small, explicit, reviewed, and testable.
requirements: Classify every surface by CDE scope state: in_scope, connected_to_cde, security_impacting, or out_of_scope.
Block tenant activation until current CDE diagrams, component inventory, and scope-change register are attached.
Require security-review approval before any new surface can move into or connect to CDE scope.
Record every scope decision as an audit event linked to the pack id, tenant id, cell id, reviewer, and evidence refs.

controls.title: Tokenization-first card data handling
controls.objective: Prevent raw PAN from spreading beyond the minimum CDE and make non-CDE payment workflows operate on substitutes.
requirements: Tokenize PAN at first controlled ingress before persistence, indexing, analytics, workflow fanout, or non-CDE service calls.
Bind token scope to tenant_id, cell_id, processor/acquirer, purpose, and data_class.
Forbid detokenization unless PDP permits the exact actor, action, tenant, purpose, token scope, and policy bundle version.
Emit audit-chain rows for token create, token rotate, detokenize attempt, detokenize success, detokenize denial, and token revoke.

controls.title: PAN, CVV, track-data, and sensitive authentication data prohibitions
controls.objective: Make prohibited storage impossible rather than process-dependent.
requirements: Refuse storage of CVV/CVC/CID, full track data, PIN, PIN block, and equivalent sensitive authentication data after authorization.
Refuse logs, traces, metrics, screenshots, debug dumps, search indexes, AI prompts, analytics features, and backups containing CVV, track data, PIN, or unmasked PAN outside the CDE.
Allow masked PAN only through display-specific permits and only where adjacent fields cannot reconstruct the PAN.
Make derived features inherit the most restrictive input data class; no laundering of PAN/SAD into lower classes.

controls.title: KMS, HSM, BYOK, rotation, and cryptographic shred
controls.objective: Bind cardholder data encryption to tenant/cell/purpose-specific key custody and auditable key use.
requirements: Require encryption_byok_required=true or an approved tenant/customer-managed key custody exception for every PCI pack activation.
Partition keys by tenant, cell, environment, data class, and purpose; shared global keys are refused for cardholder data.
Require PDP authorization receipt before KMS encrypt, decrypt, rewrap, schedule deletion, cancel deletion, or cryptographic shred actions.
Rotate CDE keys on the defined cadence, on personnel/access change, on suspected compromise, and before key-policy major-version activation.
Emit audit-chain evidence for key creation, import/BYOK proof, rotation, decrypt, denied decrypt, schedule deletion, cancellation, and shred completion.

controls.title: Embedded PDP default-deny for every CDE action
controls.objective: Ensure code never decides PCI policy and every CDE decision is attributable.
requirements: Represent CDE actions as Cedar/PDP actions with explicit principal, tenant, resource, purpose, data_class, cell, policy_version, and pack context.
Default deny every CDE action unless a signed policy bundle permits the exact action and no forbid applies.
Fail closed when policy is stale, action mapping is unknown, bundle validation fails, decision id cannot be minted, or audit-chain emission fails.
Keep duties separated: pack authors cannot self-approve policy bundles; CDE operators cannot self-grant detokenization or key-decrypt rights.

controls.title: Segmentation, vulnerability scanning, ASV scans, and penetration testing
controls.objective: Prove non-CDE surfaces cannot reach CDE paths and externally reachable CDE surfaces stay scan-clean.
requirements: Default-deny network policy around CDE cells, namespaces, queues, topics, object buckets, backup stores, KMS endpoints, and admin planes.
Run internal vulnerability scans on CDE components at least quarterly and after significant changes.
Run external vulnerability scans through an Approved Scanning Vendor at least quarterly and after significant external-surface changes; failed scans block tenant activation and renewal.
Run penetration tests and segmentation tests before activation, annually, and after significant CDE or connected-to-CDE changes.
Record scan windows, target inventories, findings, remediation, re-scan evidence, and accepted-risk exceptions in the audit/evidence pack.
source_row_strategy: PCI-DSS-V4-0-1-STANDARD for exact requirement text after permitted acquisition
PCI-DSS-V4-0-1-ASV-PROGRAM for Approved Scanning Vendor cadence/scope/failure treatment before scan evidence acceptance

controls.title: ROC, AOC, QSA, and service-provider evidence chain
controls.objective: Make Level 1 validation auditable before tenant activation claims are made.
requirements: Maintain annual QSA-led Report on Compliance and Attestation of Compliance for every Oyatie-managed service-provider CDE boundary.
Bind each ROC/AOC control response to evidence refs, owners, dates, system components, compensating controls, and remediation tickets.
Refuse pack activation when QSA evidence is expired, scoped to the wrong CDE, missing service-provider responsibility mapping, or inconsistent with current data-flow diagrams.
Expose only approved customer-facing AOC/Responsibility Matrix evidence; keep detailed ROC evidence tenant-restricted and auditor-scoped.
source_row_strategy: PCI-DSS-V4-0-1-STANDARD for exact requirement text after permitted acquisition
PCI-DSS-V4-0-1-ROC-TEMPLATE for Report on Compliance evidence index shape
PCI-DSS-V4-0-1-AOC-TEMPLATE for customer-facing Attestation of Compliance packet boundary
PCI-DSS-V4-0-1-QSA-PROGRAM for QSA engagement/assessor authority and evidence sufficiency

controls.title: CDE logging, audit-chain retention, and observability redaction
controls.objective: Preserve useful forensic evidence without leaking card data into telemetry stores.
requirements: Emit audit events for every CDE access, authorization decision, KMS operation, tokenization event, admin action, scan event, segmentation change, evidence approval, incident action, and pack activation transition.
Retain audit-log history for at least one year, with the most recent three months immediately available for investigation unless a stricter tenant/regulatory overlay applies.
Redact PAN/SAD at emission boundaries; telemetry storage is never the redaction boundary.
Link logs, metrics, traces, and audit rows by trace_id, span_id, event_id, tenant_id, cell_id, and audit_id; include pack_id and data_class where applicable.
Legal hold can extend retention but cannot authorize storage of CVV/track/PIN or recreate prohibited data.

controls.title: PCI incident response and breach workflow readiness
controls.objective: Keep payment-card incident handling ready before card data enters the platform.
requirements: Maintain a PCI-specific incident response runbook covering detection, containment, token/key revocation, forensic preservation, acquirer/payment-brand notification, customer communication, regulator coordination, and post-incident control uplift.
Drill the PCI incident workflow at least annually and after material CDE architecture changes.
Preserve volatile and durable forensic evidence without copying raw PAN/SAD into case-management, chat, ticket, AI, or document tools outside approved auditor scope.
Pre-authorize emergency access through break-glass Cedar fragments with time-bound approval, dual control, audit evidence, and post-use review.

controls.title: Tenant PCI pack activation and renewal gates
controls.objective: Prevent any tenant from enabling PCI card-data handling until CDE, policy, key, evidence, and scan prerequisites are green.
requirements: Tenant activation requires PCI-DSS-L1-v4 pack installation, approved business/payment role, KYB/KYC status where applicable, processor/acquirer mapping, and explicit responsibility matrix acceptance.
Tenant home and DR cells must be PCI-DSS-L1-attested or explicitly token-only out-of-scope with QSA-reviewed evidence.

Activation requires current passing ASV evidence, valid AOC/ROC/QSA evidence, CDE data-flow evidence, KMS key-custody evidence, PDP bundle evidence, audit retention evidence, and incident response drill evidence.

Activation is revoked or suspended on expired scans, expired AOC/ROC, failed segmentation test, stale policy bundle, key custody failure, unremediated high/critical vulnerability, or prohibited-data detection.
Renewal re-evaluates all activation evidence and records delta from the previous activation packet.

permit_conditions_all: tenant payment role and processor/acquirer responsibility matrix are approved
home/dr cells satisfy PCI-DSS-L1-attested or QSA-approved token-only out-of-scope posture
PDP bundle is signed, current, and carries explicit permit/forbid fixtures for requested card-data actions
KMS key set is tenant/cell/data-class scoped and BYOK/HSM evidence is current
CDE scope packet, data-flow diagrams, and component inventory are current
ASV scan, segmentation test, and vulnerability remediation evidence are current and passing
QSA/AOC/ROC evidence is current and matches the requested scope
Audit retention and incident response readiness evidence is current
deny_conditions_any: CVV, full track data, PIN, or raw PAN detected outside CDE
unmasked PAN in logs, traces, metrics, search, analytics, backups, tickets, documents, prompts, screenshots, or debug dumps outside approved CDE evidence scope
failed segmentation test or unapproved CDE connectivity
stale PDP bundle or unaudited PDP decision path
KMS key-custody failure or decrypt path without authorization receipt
missing incident response runbook or overdue drill
